scope: Expanded production publisher path under connected persistent delivery faults
verified_assertions: Snapshot failure produces one rejection and no successful delivery diagnostic
Lost/uncertain delivery performs one delivery and one status reconciliation without child activation
Late delivery cancels the resident workflow, releases controls, and produces no child sequence event
Child remains leased with attempt_count 1 rather than being replayed
Saved retained-plan and action-request rows remain present
limits: Three mode runs overlap coverage and are not six distinct lifecycle scenarios
Authority/perception and successor-context resolution remain fixtures
Snapshot-failure fixture explicitly saves after clearing the fault; not power-loss durability proof
No live Minecraft capacity, provider latency or five-stage timing closure
